Relevant information:

- Item 2 (2023-03-11): The user said they use a new grocery list app and had been trying to get their mom to use it, but she was still on her old paper list.
- Item 1 (2023-04-30): The user said their mom is now using the same grocery list app as them, so they can share lists.

The April 30 statement is the later one and updates the March 11 one. The question is asked on 2023-05-14, and nothing later contradicts it.

Answer: Yes. Your mom used to keep a paper list, but as of April 30 she uses the same grocery list app as you, and you two can share lists.
